thread:
shayla (Customer): Hey team — getting multiple reports that p99 for 'velvet' generation endpoints jumped overnight. Baseline was ~320ms, now seeing 2.2s-3.0s on requests with long context (>8k tokens). Customers hitting timeouts.

devin (SRE): Do we have a sample request id / region? Any recent deploys?

shayla (Customer): req_id: r-0a9f3c2e, region: eu-west1-1. Happened after the model onboarding last night. No other infra changes on that host.

ben (ML Eng): Velvet onboarding included velvet-bpe-v2 tokenizer and we turned on kv_prefetch to reduce runtime kv lookups for long context. Curious if pre-tokenize step is now dominating. Can you paste the request payload (sanitized)?

shayla (Customer): here's minimal repro (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "velvet:2026-03-14",
  "input": "<8.5k tokens of customer transcript...>",
  "stream": false
}
```

maria (Support): I pulled the trace from the request id — adding it here: https://redwood.internal/traces/r-0a9f3c2e (private) — shows large time in "tokenizer.preprocess" and a spike in "kv_prefetch" step.

infra-bot: [alert] deployment/velvet-onboard v2026-03-14-23:37 applied to eu-west1-1 (hosts: gpu-12,gpu-13).

devin (SRE): Can you run a lightweight debug call with ?trace=1 (will add console timings) so we can see breakdown of preprocess vs runtime?

shayla (Customer): ran it:
```
{
  "timings": {
    "http_total_ms": 2345,
    "tokenizer_ms": 1876,
    "kv_prefetch_ms": 1420,
    "runtime_attention_ms": 300
  },
  "status": "slow-p99",
  "req_id": "r-0a9f3c2e"
}
```

ben (ML Eng): Whoa tokenizer_ms + kv_prefetch_ms > http_total because they overlap in tracing window, but clearly tokenizer+prefetch dominating. kv_prefetch was supposed to run asynchronously but we toggled a synchronous fallback for onboarding to avoid cache misses — looks like that fallback is forcing blocking prefetch.

devin (SRE): I'm spinning up a canary to flip kv_prefetch -> false for 10% traffic on velvet in eu-west1-1. Will watch p95/p99.

deploy-bot: Executing: redwoodctl rollout patch model velvet --region eu-west1-1 --set "kv_prefetch=false" --percent 10

devin (SRE): Canary live. Observing incoming samples.

maria (Support): Customer-facing ticket updated: "We're applying a temporary config change to reduce tail latency, will update within 30m." :white_check_mark:

(12m later)

devin (SRE): Canary results: p50~310ms, p95~480ms, p99~570ms on canary. Non-canary still p99~2.7s. Looks promising.

ben (ML Eng): That matches hypothesis. kv_prefetch synchronous fallback added to avoid correctness regressions when tokenizer output changed shape for rare sequences. Need to fix tokenizer so we can re-enable async prefetch safely.

shayla (Customer): Canary reduction confirmed by customer — no more timeouts for sample workloads.

devin (SRE): Rolling to 100% for velvet in eu-west1-1 now. Command: redwoodctl rollout finalize model velvet --region eu-west1-1 --set "kv_prefetch=false"

deploy-bot: Rollout complete. velvet kv_prefetch=false applied to 100% traffic in eu-west1-1.

maria (Support): Monitoring dashboards show p99 down from ~2.7s -> ~560ms across cluster. Informing customer and closing the urgent ticket. :thumbsup:

ben (ML Eng): Action items: (1) Fix tokenizer edge-case that caused shape mismatch with async prefetch, add unit tests for long-context tokenization (2) Add e2e perf test with 12k token sequences to gating, (3) Add alert on tokenizer_ms > 400ms on avg for long-context workloads.

devin (SRE): I'll open infra task to add the alert and add a playbook step for kv_prefetch rollback.

maria (Support): Recording postmortem notes in the support dossier and tagging accounts affected.

shayla (Customer): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick rollback. Please ping when tokenizer fix is deployed so we can try re-enabling prefetch.

ben (ML Eng): Will follow up with a PR link once ready.

infra-bot: [note] follow-up ticket created: INFRA-1287 "velvet tokenizer async-prefetch regression" assigned to ben.

maria (Support): resolved for now, reassign to dev backlog for permanent fix.

shayla (Customer): closing from customer side, all good.
